title: AI may find cancer earlier, but cures still need people
teaser: The AI industry keeps promising that cancer will be treatable within 5–10 years, or at least within our lifetimes. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has made that case; OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has suggested that 10 gigawatts of computing could help AI work out how to cure cancer. Yet the clinical reality is narrower: AI is helping detect tumors, analyze medical images and shape treatment plans, while no AI-developed drug has completed the full journey from regulatory approval to reimbursement and routine clinical use.
